<thought>To obtain the possible precursors, I first need to locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the described carbonyl‑ene intramolecular reaction. I will search the template catalog for a template that breaks a ketone and an alkene, forms an alcohol, and creates a new C‑C bond (ring‑forming) and a C‑O bond. Once I have the template ID, I will apply it to the target molecule to get all precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)", "6-8 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
